Common questions about Meetily's FERPA compliance, student data protection, and educational features

children.a: Yes, Meetily is designed to be FERPA compliant through its local processing architecture. All data processing happens on your infrastructure, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance with student privacy requirements.

children.q: How does Meetily protect student data?
children.a: Meetily protects student data through multiple layers of security: local processing ensuring data never leaves your network, automatic PII detection and redaction, role-based access control, and detailed audit logging. All processing happens within your secure infrastructure.

children.q: Can Meetily be used for remote learning?
children.a: Yes, Meetily is ideal for remote learning scenarios. It provides secure, FERPA-compliant documentation for virtual classrooms, online consultations, and distance learning programs while maintaining student privacy.

children.q: How does local processing ensure student privacy?
children.a: Local processing means all data processing happens within your own infrastructure, not on external servers. This ensures complete control over student information, meeting FERPA's privacy and security requirements. No student data ever leaves your secure environment.

children.q: What security measures are in place for educational data?
children.a: Meetily implements multiple security measures: AES-256 encryption, secure authentication, role-based access control, detailed audit trails, and automatic PII detection and protection. All processing happens locally within your secure infrastructure.
